key_findings: Luteolin alleviates CIA-associated chronic pain by blocking an LDHA/H3K9la/NFATC2 axis that drives Th17 differentiation and spinal infiltration.
NFATC2 knockdown in CD4+ T cells reduced spinal IL-17A, pSTAT3, IBA1 and improved pain thresholds in CIA mice.
